This Lease Agreement is made on October 1, 2024, between Landlord Properties LLC (Landlord) and Jane Doe (Tenant). The term is 12 months, beginning November 1, 2024, and ending October 31, 2025. Rent is $1,800 per month, due on the first. Late fee of $50 applies after the 5th. Security deposit is $2,700. Pets are not allowed without written consent. Tenant is responsible for minor repairs up to $100. Landlord will maintain structural elements and appliances. Quiet hours are from 10 PM to 8 AM. This agreement is binding upon signing.

Tenant acknowledges receipt of the lease terms and agrees to abide by all rules and regulations of the building.
